messages:
Ashley M: Quick heads-up — planned rollout in the 22:00 UTC change window. Need a quick readiness call for API/runtime/console/router. Listing the service versions we'll push:
- api: v4.2.1
- runtime: r3.10-quant
- console: web-2.0.4
- router: rtr-1.9.0

Raj P: Runtime note — r3.10-quant changes KV eviction threshold. If traffic is bursty we may see elevated miss rates for ~3-5 min while caches warm. Recommendation: prewarm by sending low-priority warmup traffic 10m before flip. 

Mina K: Console change includes the new route for the rollout page. It reads model metadata from api/v1/models. Make sure api v4.2.1 keeps the schema (modelId, variants[], metadata.version). If not, console will 500.

Dave L: Router compatibility check: rtr-1.9.0 expects the new header X-Model-Variant, optional. It will tolerate absence, but we should start adding it from API to be safe. Also confirm rollout token TTL doesn't shrink below 60s.

Ashley M: Good catch. Raj — can you confirm the eviction threshold value and whether it's tunable at runtime?

Raj P: It's set to 0.18 by default in r3.10-quant. Tunable via /admin/kv/config but changing it requires restarting the runtime workers. Not ideal during window.

Ashley M: OK, plan: 1) Deploy API -> v4.2.1 (no worker restart), 2) Deploy router -> rtr-1.9.0, 3) Deploy runtime in passive mode (no eviction tweak), 4) Flip console route. If we see cache pressure, we rollback runtime only. Agreed?

Mina K: Agreed. Add a feature-flag gate for console flip: ff.console.rollout = off -> on. I'll prepare the toggle.

Dave L: Router team preflight: run this healthcheck against staging then prod:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://router.prod.internal/health
```
Expect 200 and latency < 120ms.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job created by @ashley. Job ID: dlg-20251102-175432. Window: 2025-11-02 22:00 UTC. Components: api:v4.2.1, router:rtr-1.9.0, runtime:r3.10-quant, console:web-2.0.4

Ashley M: Rollback criteria (quick summary): any 5xx spike > 1% sustained for 3 minutes OR router error rate > 0.5% for 5 minutes OR runtime OOMs on >1 host. If hit, we revert the last component that changed and cut the window.

Raj P: I'll be on-call for runtime. I’ll watch miss rate and memory.

Mina K: I'll hold the FF switch until I see API logs confirming model schema preserved.

Dave L: Router team will have a config to drop X-Model-Variant if downstream can't handle it. We'll leave it off for the first two minutes, then enable gradually.

Ashley M: Release notes: I'll draft minimal notes and call out the schema compatibility check. Anyone want to add bullet points?

Raj P: Add: 'KV policy unchanged; runtime binary upgraded with quant kernels; no config changes expected.'

Mina K: Add console item: 'New rollout UI behind feature flag; will be enabled after API verification.'

Dave L: :thumbsup:

Ashley M: Great. Final check-in 21:45 UTC in #eng-releases. If no blockers, proceed with the sequence. Thanks.
